name: Smoky Chicken, Mushroom, Pepper & Tomato Sauté over Rice with Arugula

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups basmati rice
3 cup water

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
6 caps portobello mushrooms
3 yellow bell peppers
1 ½ (5 oz) pkgs baby arugula

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
Meanwhile, pat the chicken dry with paper towels. Place in a large bowl, season with spices, and toss to coat.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 lb chicken thighs, boneless skinless
2 tbsp smoked paprika
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add chicken and cook until golden, about 2 minutes per side (it will not be cooked all the way through). Remove to a plate. (Reserve pot with drippings for later use.)
Meanwhile, remove stems from portobello mushrooms; halve lengthwise, then cut crosswise into ½-inch thick pieces. Place in a clean large bowl.
Trim, seed, and slice bell peppers lengthwise into thin strips. Add to the bowl with the mushroom.

When the chicken is done, return pot to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add mushroom, bell pepper, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 4-5 minutes. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper
¾ tsp crushed red pepper
¾ tsp garlic powder

instructions.primary_message: Add tomatoes to the pot and stir to combine the sauce. Nestle seared chicken into the sauce and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, reduce heat to medium and cook, stirring occasionally, until the chicken is cooked through and sauce is thickened slightly, 6-8 minutes. Cover and remove from heat.
Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, Dijon, honey, salt, and pepper in the reserved bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
2 tbsp white wine vinegar
1 ½ tsp Dijon mustard
1 ½ tsp honey
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Just before serving, add arugula to the bowl with the dressing and toss to combine the salad.
Divide rice, chicken, and sauce between plates or bowls. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!
